_format: expect_pages: list of groups; every group must be cited (any page ID inside a group counts). expect_not_documented: answer must say 'Not documented in the DGX-670 manuals'. notes: what a correct answer contains (for human review).

questions.question: How do I make the ACMP button be off by default when I turn the keyboard on?
questions.notes: [MENU] → Cursor buttons [▲][▼][◀][▶] Style Setting, [ENTER] → TAB [◀][▶] Setting2 → Cursor button [▲] 1 ACMP On/Off Default [OM p.50].

questions.question: How do I change where the keyboard splits between my left-hand and right-hand sounds?
questions.notes: Split Point procedure in 'Changing the Split Points' [OM p.58] (default F#2 per OM p.38).

questions.question: How do I change the metronome's time signature and turn the bell on the first beat on or off?
questions.notes: Path via [MENU] → Metronome Setting [OM p.44]; Metronome page: [3▲▼]–[5▲▼] Sound (bell accent), [6▲▼]/[7▲▼] Time Signature [RM p.5].

questions.question: Can I create my own Style from scratch, and where do I start?
questions.notes: Style Creator: [MENU] → Cursor buttons [▲][▼][◀][▶] Style Creator, [ENTER] [OM p.59]; full procedure in RM Ch3 'Creating/Editing Styles (Style Creator)' [RM p.26+].

questions.question: Where on the Main display is the Registration Memory Bank name shown?
questions.notes: Callout (5) on the Main display figure [OM p.23]; location must come from the figure description [FIG OM-023-f1] — verify against the PDF page.

questions.question: Looking at the rear panel, which connector is at the far left and which is at the far right?
questions.notes: Rear panel figure with callouts (1)–(7) [OM p.14, FIG OM-014-f1]; positions come only from the figure — verify against the PDF page.

questions.question: If I press the DIRECT ACCESS button and then the MIXER/EQ button, which display comes up?
questions.notes: OM p.22 defers to the Direct Access Chart in the Data List [DL p.78]; answer is the chart row for [MIXER/EQ].

questions.question: My keyboard keeps turning itself off. Why, and how do I stop that?
questions.notes: Auto Power Off: default time, how to change it, and the simple disable method [OM p.17].

questions.question: What is the weight of the power adapter cable?
questions.notes: Not documented. Closest: Specifications (instrument weight 21.4 kg, power adaptor info) [OM p.106–107].

questions.question: Can I install third-party VST plugins on the DGX-670?
questions.notes: Not documented. Closest: computer connection via [USB TO HOST] [OM p.92] / Connections chapter.
